thread:
sarah.ops: Quick reminder  vendor roadmap sync TOMORROW 9am PT. Focus: SKU regional flags, embargo durations, SI onramp order (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi), and a practical fallback plan if a vendor misses a wave.

ton y-partner: Can we get explicit embargo numbers from each vendor? Last time we had mixed asks (7-10 days) and it forced multiple press windows. Need a clear ask in the pre-read.

mica: Marketplace note: we need stable SKU IDs across clouds and per-region availability bits so UI can grey out unavailable SKUs. Also want a "compatibility_family" tag for fallback routing.

press_ops: Press needs: vendor embargo_days, whether firmware/microcode is embargoed separately, and any preferred blackout windows. If vendor embargo >=14 days we'll need legal early.

vendor_bot: Vendor preflight form: https://forms.redwood.example/hw-onramp-embargo (fields: eta_signoff, embargo_days, microcode_embargo_boolean, region_limits). Auto-reminder in 12h.

infra_mgr: Infrastructure update: conservative H100 Dedicated pool GA target 2025-06-20; H200 follow-up late July; MI300 distribution starting late June for NA, but eu-west may lag by ~10 days; Gaudi revB patching still ETA mid-May per partner engineering.

si_ash: SI asks: prioritized onboarding order should be H100/H200 -> MI300 -> Gaudi/B200. Need canary AMIs for all clouds, driver bundles, and an integration window calendar so SI teams can book runbooks. Also request quant export scripts (int8/4bit) where available.

sarah.ops: Proposal for announce waves (slightly different than past plans): Wave 1 (invite-only canary + Dedicated): H100 + H200 fallback support. Wave 2 (wider hosted + Dedicated): MI300 + H200 GA. Wave 3 (economy lane): Gaudi + B200. Space waves by 2-3 weeks but allow embargo-driven extension.

mica: Suggest adding an explicit fallback mapping and notification flow. Example snippet to share with vendors: `fallback_map: -from: H100-v1 -to_family: H200-family -ui_label: "H100-compatible" -reason: supply_or_driver`

press_ops: Add runbook item for embargo mismatch: hold public announce, run partner triage call within 2 hours, enable fallback SKU regionally, and notify customers via status. Owner: press_ops / partner-ops.

legal_review: Note  firmware or microcode marked as embargoed counts as separate IP-sensitive asset; we need to capture that explicitly in the form to trigger legal review.

infra_mgr: Canary telemetry ask: 30d retention as baseline for first wave; infra can allocate temporary buckets and will attach cost estimate to the tracker. Also recommend a small golden canary cohort (100 instances) to validate KV-cache and batching behaviors.

si_ash: On quantization: internal sims show MI300 int8 paths can cut token cost dramatically but need performance validation; please request prebuilt quant artifacts or scripts from vendors in the sync.

tony-partner: Habana update from partner eng: revB still has a long-seq streaming kernel race; patch ETA May 17. If patch slips beyond 72h, vendors propose moving Gaudi to Wave 3 strictly.

sarah.ops: Action items before sync: 1) vendors fill preflight form, 2) infra publish tentative canary plan + cost, 3) marketplace produce SKU taxonomy + region flags, 4) SI upload integration checklist template, 5) press collect embargo numbers per vendor.

vendor_bot: Preflight link again: https://forms.redwood.example/hw-onramp-embargo (deadline EOD).

mica: Who will own the compatibility matrix presentation in the sync? Ravi or SI_ash?

si_ash: I'll present the SI view and walk through the checklist. Will also show a sample AMI/image naming convention.

sarah.ops: Great. If you can't make 9am PT DM me and we'll do a vendor 1:1. See you all tomorrow. :calendar: :rocket:
